---
applyTo: "archive/**"
---

# Archive Map

Archive Root: `/archive`

## Directories
- `/archive` — Markdown documents
- `/archive/assets` — Binary assets (images, PDFs, etc.)

## Filename Convention
`YYYY-MM-DD_slug.md`

## Metadata Fields (fixed order)
Top-of-file metadata should use bold inline labels in this exact order: `**ID:**`, `**Title:**`, `**Author:**`, `**Date:**`, `**Tags:**`.

## Rules
- Never add new top-level directories.
- All assets go in `/archive/assets` only.
- Asset references must use relative paths.
